title: Obsidian-Intelligence Layer — Stabilization + Autonomous Workflows + HTML Outputs + Company Brain + IdeaBlock RAG + Capture Surfaces + Agent Observability
brief: Atomized envelope synthesized from OBSIDIAN-INTELLIGENCE-MS3-UNIFIED-PLAN.md (claude-cee63f1f, 2026-05-09). 24 units across 7 tracks. Track A (stabilization, 2u) unblocks everything by killing xmalloc OOMs via persistent prism-hooks Docker broker + finishing the Write|Edit|MultiEdit matcher on the reread-signal hook. Track B (6 autonomous workflows from cyrilXBT) ships compounding daily/weekly value via Daily Context, Connection Finder, Queue Processor, Weekly Synthesis, Project Auto-Updater, Knowledge Distillation. Track C (3 HTML outputs from Thariq/Anthropic playbook) makes Claude-generated reports info-dense + interactive (no more 100-line markdown walls). Track D (5 Company Brain units from Sentra/Ashwin reframe) adds provenance, ontology, conflict resolution, action traces, and context-evaluation gates — the BIG architectural shift. Track E (4 IdeaBlock RAG units from Akshay Pachaar/Blockify pattern) replaces chunk-window retrieval with question+validated-answer atomic blocks (~40x corpus reduction, ~2.3x retrieval relevance). Track F (2 capture surfaces) ships voice memo watcher + PDF highlights-only ingest. Track G (3 agent observability from darkzodchi 3-rule playbook) adds narrow job descriptions + pixel-dept overlay + runtime alerts. Sources: 5 X articles fetched via jina reader (state/shared/x-fetch/), 6 shipped OBSIDIAN-VIZ-MS0 units, 3 in-flight MS2 units, U-DOCKER-HOOK-BROKER handoff. Original spec: state/shared/specs/OBSIDIAN-INTELLIGENCE-MS3-UNIFIED-PLAN.md.

phases.title: Stabilization (PREREQ for everything)
phases.rationale: Without A1 (DOCKER-BROKER), every other unit suffers xmalloc OOMs that are blocking the 6-chat fleet right now. Land A1+A2 first.

units.title: U-DOCKER-HOOK-BROKER — persistent prism-hooks container holds all 50+ hooks warm
exit_conditions: Docker container 'prism-hooks' runs persistently with all hook scripts pre-loaded
Hook-broker dispatcher proxies PreToolUse/PostToolUse/Stop/SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit events to the container via HTTP/IPC
Per-event cold-start eliminated (xmalloc OOMs across 6 chats observed to drop to zero in 24h burn-in)
Fallback to legacy in-process node execution if container is down (graceful degrade)
Round-trip test: 50 rapid PreToolUse fires complete with zero forked-process failures

deliverables.description: Container definition with node + all hook source files baked in
HTTP client that routes hook events to the container with timeout + fallback
Burn-in test: 100 concurrent hook fires with fork-storm prevention

units.rollback: Stop + remove container; revert .claude/helpers/docker-hook-broker.mjs; settings.json reverts to direct hook execution

units.title: U-REREAD-SIGNAL-FINISH — wire Write|Edit|MultiEdit matcher so recall counter sees writes (currently fires only on Reads)
exit_conditions: WikiRecallCounterEngine.recordEvent() fires on Write/Edit/MultiEdit (not only Read)
Existing 22/22 tests still pass
New 3 tests: write/edit/multiedit increment counter
PostToolUse hook matcher updated in settings.json

deliverables.description: Mirror of wiki-recall-on-read.mjs but for write events

units.rollback: Remove hook entry from settings.json; the new helper module is harmless if unwired

phases.title: Autonomous Workflows (cyrilXBT 6-workflow playbook)
phases.rationale: Vault-writes-back-to-itself pattern. 6 cron + watcher workflows produce compounding daily/weekly value from existing memory + wiki + inbox content.

units.title: U-DAILY-CONTEXT-WORKFLOW — synthesize yesterday's daily note + active projects + inbox into morning brief
exit_conditions: 6 AM cron writes knowledge/memories/generated/DAILY-CONTEXT-YYYY-MM-DD.md
Output references at least 3 source files (yesterday's note + 1 project overview + ≥1 inbox item)
Ollama qwen2.5-coder summarizer used (token-economy compliant)
Test: dry-run on fixture inputs produces deterministic markdown

deliverables.description: Reads yesterday's daily note + project overviews + inbox, emits brief via Ollama

units.rollback: Disable scheduled task; engine stays unwired

units.title: U-CONNECTION-FINDER — weekly cron finds non-obvious cross-domain/contradiction/evidence connections
exit_conditions: Sun 6 AM cron writes knowledge/memories/generated/CONNECTIONS-YYYY-WW.md
Connection types tagged: cross-domain | contradiction | evidence
Uses Qdrant cosine similarity to find candidate pairs, Ollama to rank novelty
Test: known-pairs corpus surfaces ≥80% of seeded connections
units.rollback: Disable scheduled task

units.title: U-QUEUE-PROCESSOR — fs.watch knowledge/memories/queue/ for RESEARCH-X/SYNTHESIZE-X/DRAFT-X files, process via Ollama or Claude (size-gated)
exit_conditions: Watcher service running (cron OR Stop hook poll, 2h cadence)
File naming: RESEARCH-*.md | SYNTHESIZE-*.md | DRAFT-*.md
Output to knowledge/memories/generated/<basename>-output.md
Input file moves to knowledge/memories/archive/ on completion
Token-budget gate: <2KB input → Ollama, ≥2KB → Claude queue (manual)
Test: 3 fixture files → 3 outputs + 3 archived
units.rollback: Stop daemon; files in queue/ stay untouched

units.title: U-WEEKLY-SYNTHESIS — Sunday 8 PM retro: 4-question synthesis of the week
exit_conditions: Sun 8 PM cron writes knowledge/memories/generated/WEEKLY-YYYY-WW.md
4 sections: moved / didn't move / emerging patterns / top-3 next-week leverage
Reads last 7 DAILY-CONTEXT files for input
Test: dry-run on 7-day fixture produces all 4 sections
units.rollback: Disable scheduled task

units.title: U-PROJECT-AUTO-UPDATER — fs.watch project subfolders, auto-update overview.md with one-line change summary
exit_conditions: fs.watch fires on knowledge/projects/*/file change events
Ollama summarizes diff to one line, appended to project's overview.md '## Recent activity' section
Last 20 lines retained, older drop into archive section
Test: simulated 5 file changes produce 5 summary lines in overview.md
units.rollback: Stop daemon; overview.md files unchanged going forward

units.title: U-KNOWLEDGE-DISTILLATION — monthly distill 30 days of resources/areas notes into canonical per-topic references
exit_conditions: 1st-of-month cron writes knowledge/wiki/distillations/YYYY-MM-<topic>.md
Topic clusters derived from IdeaBlock embeddings (depends on E2 dedup)
Source memo paths preserved in distillation frontmatter
Test: 30-day fixture yields ≥3 distillation files with valid frontmatter
units.rollback: Disable scheduled task

phases.title: HTML Output Mode (Thariq/Anthropic playbook)
phases.rationale: Claude-generated specs/reports should be info-dense HTML (SVG, tables, interactivity, scripts) once outputs exceed ~100 lines. Direct relevance to CLAUDE-BRIEF, BUILD_STATE, scrutiny reports.

units.title: U-HTML-OUTPUT-MODE — add --html flag to generate-claude-brief / generate-system-viz / build-state-snapshot
exit_conditions: --html flag generates HTML alongside markdown (no replacement)
Each HTML file embeds SVG/tables/color-coded status
Standalone (no external CDN deps for offline open)
Test: --html flag produces valid HTML5 + asserts presence of <svg> + <table>
units.rollback: Remove --html flag handling; markdown output unchanged

units.title: U-HTML-DASHBOARD — unified state/shared/system-viz/dashboard.html aggregating viz + brief + build_state + scrutiny + recall top-20 + chat-bus + workboard
exit_conditions: dashboard.html opens in browser without dependencies (self-contained)
7 panels: viz embed, CLAUDE-BRIEF, BUILD_STATE, scrutiny ledger, recall top-20, chat-bus presence, workboard
Auto-regenerates on Stop hook (T3, non-blocking)
Test: panel HTML validates + each panel has ≥1 data row

deliverables.description: Stop hook firing dashboard regen async

units.rollback: Remove Stop hook entry; dashboard.html stays as last-generated snapshot

units.title: U-HTML-DESIGN-SYSTEM — extract PRISM design system reference from mcp-server/web/ so HTML generations match style
exit_conditions: state/shared/design-system.html catalogs colors, fonts, button styles, layouts from mcp-server/web/
C1+C2 outputs import design system tokens (CSS vars)
Visual consistency check: dashboard.html + claude-brief.html share palette
Test: design-system.html lists ≥10 components with usage examples
units.rollback: Delete extracted file; downstream HTML generators fall back to inline styles

phases.title: Company Brain (Sentra/Ashwin reframe — BIGGEST architectural shift)
phases.rationale: Markdown brains hit scale walls without provenance, ontology, conflict resolution, action traces, evals. JM Die is multi-user → we're at organizational scale. Allow 2-3 sessions; this is foundational.

units.title: U-PROVENANCE-LAYER — every memory/wiki entry gets source frontmatter (agent, sessionId, writeEvent, parentMemory?)
exit_conditions: Frontmatter validates via new Zod schema: { agent, sessionId, writeEvent, parentMemory? }
memory-mirror-to-vault.mjs auto-enriches on write
WikiRecallCounterEngine reads provenance to weight recall freshness
Migration: existing memos backfilled where derivable from filename/mtime
Test: 5 fixture writes produce valid provenance blocks; missing fields rejected
units.rollback: Remove enrichment from mirror script; existing provenance stays as inert frontmatter

units.title: U-ONTOLOGY-LAYER — explicit type tagging fact|interpretation, current|deprecated|draft, public|internal|confidential
exit_conditions: New MemoryOntologyEngine validates frontmatter ontology fields
Zod enum schemas for kind | state | visibility
Memory mirror rejects writes with missing/invalid ontology
Backfill applied where heuristically derivable
Test: 6 fixture writes (3 valid, 3 invalid) → 3 accept + 3 reject
units.rollback: Loosen validator to warn-only mode

units.title: U-CONFLICT-RESOLUTION — when 2 chats edit same memory key concurrently, capture both versions in conflicts/<key>.diff.md
exit_conditions: MemoryConflictResolverEngine detects concurrent writes via SHA256 + timestamp window
Conflict policies enum: last-writer | first-writer | human-arbitrate
On conflict: write knowledge/memories/conflicts/<key>.diff.md with both versions + winner
Test: simulated 2-chat race produces conflict file + correct winner
Confirm with user that semantic conflicts are different from file-level (commit-ownership-guard already exists)
units.rollback: Disable detection; last-writer-wins becomes implicit default

units.title: U-ACTION-TRACES — log every agent write as graph edge (agent, prompt-hash, tool, target-memory, timestamp)
exit_conditions: Append-only JSONL at state/shared/action-traces.jsonl
Edge schema: { ts, agent, sessionId, promptHash, tool, target, action }
Queryable via prism_session:action_trace_query dispatcher action
system-viz adds action-trace overlay layer (read-only timeline)
Test: 10 simulated writes → 10 JSONL entries + query returns by-agent and by-target filters
units.rollback: Stop logging; existing JSONL stays as historical record

units.title: U-CONTEXT-EVAL-GATE — before any agent acts, eval whether retrieved context was complete vs golden eval set
exit_conditions: ContextEvalEngine compares retrieved-set vs ideal-set on every memory action
Golden eval set seeded manually at state/shared/context-eval-golden.json
Coverage drop > threshold → BLOCK (shop_floor) | WARN (default)
PreToolUse hook fires evaluator on memory:semantic_search responses
Test: known-coverage corpus + 5 query scenarios produce expected pass/warn/block verdicts
units.rollback: Set hook to warn-only or remove; engine stays unwired

phases.title: IdeaBlock RAG (Akshay/Blockify pattern)
phases.rationale: Chunk-window is the wrong retrieval unit. IdeaBlocks = question + validated-answer + governance fields. ~40x corpus reduction + 2.3x retrieval relevance + 13.55% accuracy gain. Direct upgrade path for ObsidianMemoryRagEngine.

units.title: U-IDEABLOCK-EXTRACTOR — convert memory/wiki .md → IdeaBlocks via Ollama structured output (qwen2.5-coder:7b)
exit_conditions: IdeaBlock schema: { question, answer(2-3 sentences), source_path, source_offset, governance_tags[] }
Ollama structured-output JSON mode used
1 .md → N IdeaBlocks (one per atomic claim)
Test: 5 fixture .md files produce expected ≥10 IdeaBlocks with valid schema
units.rollback: Stop extraction; existing IdeaBlocks remain as inert JSONL

units.title: U-IDEABLOCK-DEDUP — iterative cosine-similarity dedup at 80-85% threshold, 3-5 rounds, collapses near-duplicates
exit_conditions: Dedup uses Qdrant cosine similarity over IdeaBlock embeddings
Configurable threshold (default 0.82) and max rounds (default 4)
Per round: cluster → merge canonical → re-embed → re-cluster
Convergence detection: zero new merges in a round
Test: synthetic duplicate corpus collapses to expected canonical count
units.rollback: Skip dedup; IdeaBlocks remain raw extraction set

units.title: U-IDEABLOCK-RAG-ENGINE — replace ObsidianMemoryRagEngine chunk-window retrieval with IdeaBlock matching
exit_conditions: New IdeaBlockRagEngine implements same public API as ObsidianMemoryRagEngine (drop-in)
Retrieval returns ranked IdeaBlocks with answer + source link
Expected ≥2x retrieval relevance vs chunk-window baseline (measured via fixed eval queries)
Test: 20-query eval set shows relevance lift; A/B against old engine
units.rollback: Switch dispatcher back to ObsidianMemoryRagEngine via singleton swap

units.title: U-IDEABLOCK-GOVERNANCE — auto-tag each block with clearance | version-state | product-line | export-control
exit_conditions: Governance tags machine-applied (not author-applied) via Ollama classifier
Tags enum: clearance ∈ {public,internal,confidential} | version_state ∈ {current,deprecated,draft} | product_line ∈ {sfc,master-post,cad-cam-ai,...} | export_control ∈ {none,EAR,ITAR}
Tags persisted in IdeaBlock frontmatter
Test: known-clearance fixture corpus classified at ≥85% accuracy
units.rollback: Stop tagging; existing tags remain

phases.title: Capture Surfaces (already queued)
phases.rationale: Two contained capture flows: voice memos via Whisper + PDF-highlights-only ingest. F1 is shop-floor capture surface for JM Die operators.

units.title: U-VOICE-CAPTURE — Whisper local bridge → operator voice memos → tribal knowledge ingest (phase 1: watcher only)
exit_conditions: fs.watch on configured capture-dir for .wav/.mp3 files
Whisper (whisper.cpp or whisper-faster) local transcript → .md to knowledge/memories/inbox/
Transcript frontmatter: source=voice | captured_at | audio_path
Test: 2 fixture .wav files produce 2 inbox .md with valid frontmatter
Telegram bot deferred to Phase 2 (separate unit)
units.rollback: Stop watcher; existing transcripts retained

units.title: U-HIGHLIGHTS-ONLY — --highlights-only flag on /pdf-learn extracts only PDF highlight annotations (Adobe /Highlight subtype)
exit_conditions: PDFKnowledgeIngestEngine adds extractHighlightsOnly() method
Filter: PDF annotation subtype /Highlight only
Cuts ingest noise ≥90% vs full-body extraction on benchmark PDFs
Test: 3 fixture PDFs with mixed highlight + body → highlight-only output assertion
units.rollback: Remove flag; default full-body extraction restored

phases.title: Agent Observability (darkzodchi 3-rule playbook)
phases.rationale: Narrow job descriptions per agent + real-time visualization + runtime alerts. Replaces vibe agents with specificity.

units.title: U-AGENT-JOB-DESCRIPTIONS — codify narrow job descriptions per subagent type in AGENT_JOB_DESCRIPTIONS.md
exit_conditions: state/shared/AGENT_JOB_DESCRIPTIONS.md catalogs all ~30 subagent types
Per-agent fields: role | scope | inputs | outputs | refusal-cases
Subagent system prompts updated to reference the doc
Test: schema validates all entries; broken-refusal-case → CI fail
units.rollback: Doc stays; agents fall back to vibe behavior

units.title: U-AGENT-PIXEL-DEPT-OVERLAY — extend system-viz with agent-status overlay (idle/typing/parsing/errored) from chat-bus heartbeats
exit_conditions: generate-system-viz.mjs adds agent-status overlay layer
Status derived from chat-slots.json heartbeat age + AGENT_CHAT.jsonl latest entry
Viewer JS renders subagent nodes color-coded by status
Test: simulated 4-state chat-slots produce expected overlay JSON
units.rollback: Remove overlay layer from viz generator; viewer unchanged

units.title: U-AGENT-RUNTIME-ALERTS — watchdog: if subagent runs >N min without progress, PushNotification alert
exit_conditions: .claude/hooks/agent-watchdog.mjs polls chat-slots + AGENT_CHAT for stalled subagents
N configurable via PRISM_AGENT_WATCHDOG_STALL_MIN (default 10)
PushNotification sent on stall detection (rate-limited to 1 per agent per hour)
Test: simulated stall produces single notification; non-stall scenario silent
units.rollback: Remove hook entry from settings.json

execution_order_hint: 1. A1 + A2 (stabilize first). 2. C1 + E1 + F2 in parallel (isolated tracks). 3. B3 → B1 → B4 → B2 → B5 → B6 (workflows; B6 depends on E2). 4. D1 → D4 → D2 → D3 → D5 (Company Brain; 2-3 sessions). 5. F1 + G1-G3 in parallel after D stabilizes.
risks_open_questions: Track D5 context-eval requires golden eval set — where does ground-truth come from? Manual seed needed.
D3 vs commit-ownership-guard: PRISM already has file-level guard; D3 is for semantic memory-key conflicts (different scope). Confirm with user before building.
Track E vs Track B6: Both touch distillation. E is per-claim (IdeaBlock), B6 is per-topic (multi-claim doc). E first; B6 becomes 'render distillations from IdeaBlocks'.
Whisper scope (F1): Telegram bot for voice memos = real shop-floor capture surface. Bot deployment + auth + retention = real work. Phase F1 as just-the-watcher first.
depends_on_hard: OBSIDIAN-COMPOUND-MS1 (provides memory-mirror infrastructure that D1 extends)
OBSIDIAN-VIZ-MS0 (provides system-viz layer that G2 extends + D4 trace overlay)
